d:
The Celtics defeated the Bulls, 134-99 tonight in Boston. Payton Pritchard contributed a team-high 28 points to go with 7 three pointers, 4 assists and 2 steals, with Jayson Tatum of the Celtics adding an additional 23 points (7-17 FG, 2-5 3P) in the game. Norman Powell finished with a team-high 20 points along with 4 steals for the Bulls in the losing effort. The Celtics improve their record to 2-1 with the win, while the Bulls fall to 1-3 for the season.
